'''Usk''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA" /> that was located within the [[Usk system/Legends|Usk system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region,<ref name="EAOC" /> near [[The Cairns/Legends|The Cairns]] part of that region, and lay on the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]] called [[the Dead Road]], which connected it to the worlds of [[Elgit]] and [[Saqqar]]. A smaller hyperlane linked the planet to the world of [[Moralan]]. Usk was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Unidentified Usk species|species]] that was [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] at some point in their history, however later the species became [[Death/Legends|extinct]], leaving their home planet a derelict world.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|And then there were names I thought sounded strange and vaguely foreboding, such as Saqqar and Usk.|Jason Fry|<ref name="Suvudu">{{Suvudu|url=2009/08/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-mapping-hutt-space.html|text=STAR WARS: THE ESSENTIAL ATLAS &ndash; Mapping Hutt Space}}</ref>}}
The planet of Usk was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the planet in grid square T-10.<ref name="TEA" /> In a 2009 article published on [[Unbound Worlds|Suvudu.com]], Fry noted that the name of Usk sounded unusual and somewhat foreboding to him.<ref name="Suvudu" />
